title: Feedback on my AI-assisted Slavic mythology roguelike visuals
author: Jiggzawyr
selftext:
I've been working on a roguelike dice-building game inspired by Slavic mythology.

What do you think of the overall look based on this screenshot? Does the art style feel cohesive? Is there anything that stands out as needing improvement?

comments.author: sharkymcstevenson2
comments.body: Looks really good, love the visual

replies.author: Jiggzawyr
replies.body: I used Gemini and provided prompts describing the dark, grim, and minimalistic style I wanted, along with the rest of the visual requirements. For the Slavic creatures, I uploaded reference images of the creatures I found online to help guide the generation process. Sometimes I had to recreate the same image multiple times to get closer to the style I was aiming for. Overall, I’m quite satisfied with the results.
